# MelodyMind Quiz

> Sourced music-history quizzes with AI-generated artwork and AI-assisted, human-reviewed questions.

- [Home](https://quiz.melody-mind.de/): Decade quizzes, genre journeys, artist spotlights, and album stories
- [About and AI transparency](https://quiz.melody-mind.de/about/#ai-transparency): Research, review, sourcing, and artwork disclosure
- [Sitemap](https://quiz.melody-mind.de/sitemap-index.xml): Index of public quiz pages

Each quiz draws ten questions from a reviewed forty-question pool. Published answers
include explanations, context, and sources. Artwork is illustrative rather than
documentary.
